name: Vonage
description: Vonage Communications APIs provide programmable messaging, voice, video, verification, network, and account services.
agentUseSummary: Add a dedicated customer-owned secondary API secret, then let agents inspect only the Communications APIs account's current EUR balance and auto-reload state through one fixed read without exposing communications, content, identity, top-ups, account settings, credential administration, writes, or raw APIs.

credentialRequirements.name: VONAGE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Vonage API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the Communications APIs account identifier used only as the HTTP Basic username for the fixed balance read.

credentialRequirements.name: VONAGE_API_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Dedicated secondary API secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated 8–25 character secondary secret with upper case, lower case, and a digit. Relay encrypts it and exposes only the balance read; revoke it in Vonage Dashboard API Settings on disconnect.

capabilities.label: Read account balance
capabilities.description: Inspect the connected Communications APIs account's EUR balance and auto-reload state through one fixed read.

allowed.label: Read account balance
allowed.description: Read only the current Vonage Communications APIs account balance in EUR and whether auto-reload is enabled.

blocked.label: Block communications, content, and identity
blocked.description: SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, RCS, voice, video, Verify, Conversations, Messages, calls, recordings, transcripts, phone numbers, recipients, users, and content are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block financial and account writes
blocked.description: Top-ups, auto-reload changes, payments, pricing changes, account settings, callbacks, webhooks, subaccounts, reports, and billing mutations are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block credential administration and raw access
blocked.description: Secret listing, creation, retrieval, revocation, application/private-key/JWT management, arbitrary hosts, paths, queries, retries, writes, deletes, and raw APIs are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The one fixed balance read runs automatically; communications, content, account writes, top-ups, credential administration, and raw APIs remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same fixed read runs without Relay per-action approval; the exact credential, route, response shape, audits, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one typed balance read while Railway alone holds the customer-owned API key and dedicated secondary secret.
Relay mounts one typed balance read while Railway alone holds the customer-owned API key and dedicated secondary secret.

providerSetup.blocker: A representative Vonage Communications APIs account, dedicated secondary secret, current legal/AUP/privacy review, staging credential entry, and live validation remain for separate authorized tasks.
providerSetup.nextAction: After batch integration, an authorized account owner must create a dedicated secondary secret and validate fixed Basic authentication, the balance route, exact EUR/auto-reload response reduction, 64 KiB limit, no retry, encrypted-copy deletion, manual provider-secret revocation, and post-revocation denial.

evidence.supports: The official Account API documents fixed GET https://rest.nexmo.com/account/get-balance, HTTP Basic API-key/secret authentication, and a response containing only numeric EUR value and autoReload state.
Vonage documents the API key as account identifier, the associated API secret as authentication and billing authority, and account balance/settings/report/log semantics.
Vonage documents up to two API secrets for rotation and Dashboard or Account API revocation, supporting a dedicated secondary-secret lifecycle.
Vonage documents API Settings, account API keys, primary and secondary secrets, and separate keys for environments or use cases.
Vonage's current legal index links Communications APIs terms, general Acceptable Use Policy, messaging supplementary terms, privacy, and security materials that gate live release.
